research_question: Which execution conclusions remain scientifically defensible when market reconstruction uncertainty, latent liquidity, self-impact, strategic response, causal ambiguity, multi-fidelity simulation, distribution shift, tail events, model uncertainty, online adaptation and real historical validation are considered simultaneously?

format_days.bybit-spot:BTCUSDT: 2025-09-20 (after the vault range, in no pool; spot archive format engineering only)

pool_rule: days = SeedSequence([909013, sha256(pool)[:12]]) permutation of the calendar range; the first `count` are primary slots, the next `backups` are ordered backups

holdout_rules.explore: explore and development days are readable after the freeze by any design and are never used for confirmatory decisions
holdout_rules.confirm: confirm and confirm_late days are read only after the promotion freeze, only by sealed designs listing them; promotion fixes how many primary slots (a prefix) each hypothesis reads
holdout_rules.final: final-vault days are read once, by the single sealed final design, after close_confirmatory; no outcome statistic is inspected before the final analysis
holdout_rules.posthoc: any later reader of guarded data is posthoc and capped at EXPLORATORY

acquisition_rules.probe: header-only availability probe before the freeze (2026-10-13); see docs/v09-implementation-plan.md section 3
acquisition_rules.backup: a failed slot (HTTP error, missing archive, QUALITY_REJECTED) is replaced by the next unused backup slot of the same pool in registered order; nothing else may substitute
acquisition_rules.integrity: raw bytes hashed at download; Binance archives verified against the published .CHECKSUM; source hashes enter the ledger and never change
acquisition_rules.exhausted: if every registered option fails the dependent unit is NOT_AVAILABLE
acquisition_rules.licensing: public archives used for non-commercial research under the providers' terms; raw data are never committed or bundled

seed_namespaces.rule: SeedSequence([9, namespace id, sha256(study)[:12], index]); confirm, holdout and final require a sealed design that opened them

promotion_rules.reliability: split-half (odd/even windows) Spearman-Brown reliability of the unit-level endpoint on pilot units
promotion_rules.conclusions: an execution conclusion is carried when its explore-day pilot passes the same gate (its own threshold, unit sd, the decisions family alpha divided by the number of conclusions)
promotion_rules.transfer_candidates: the pilot record of H32, H33, H34 and H36 is that of the carried conclusion with the largest planning effect relative to its own threshold, measured on the explore streams most like the target (BTCUSDT for H32, ETHUSDT for H33, Binance for H34, all for H36); no carried conclusion -> NOT_PROMOTED_EFFECT_TOO_SMALL

power_rules.method: normal approximation of the registered decision rule; planning alpha = family alpha / family size; planning effect = pilot estimate - 1 pilot SE

statistics.interval: paired block bootstrap over units (BCa not used; percentile)
statistics.hierarchical: days -> windows two-stage bootstrap where windows matter
statistics.seed_rule: bootstrap seeds from the analysis namespace of the design

completion_constraints.residual: unfinished quantity is valued by walking the end-of-horizon book plus the registered 25 bps penalty; reported separately

mandates.side_rule: buy on even registered windows, sell on odd windows
mandates.windows: 24 per day starting at HH:10:00 UTC (HH = 0..23), each with a 30 s warmup
mandates.quantity_rule: notional / arrival mid, rounded down to the lot size

fees.note: registered retail-tier fees; costs are reported gross and net of fees separately

conclusions.rule: pilot effects on explore days decide which conclusions are carried (promoted); each carried conclusion is decided by both bounded-replay cost bounds (historically identified only when the bounds agree) with Holm over the carried set

realism_gate.reference: day-to-day real variation: the 95th percentile of the same metric between pairs of held-out real days
realism_gate.acceptable: every metric of the capability within 1.0x the real-real reference and classifier AUC <= 0.60

global.ACCEPTABLE_MODEL_SET: some generator ACCEPTABLE on every capability a study needs
global.PARTIAL_MODEL_SET: otherwise, some generator at least PARTIALLY_ACCEPTABLE on each

realism_gate.fail_closed: a generator REJECTED for a capability never supports a claim that needs it

counterfactual_assumptions.identification: a pairwise direction is IDENTIFIED when the cost intervals separate on the unit; INDETERMINATE otherwise; nothing is an exact fill

causal_assumptions.rule: every causal estimand registers treatment, outcome, confounders, DAG, identification assumptions, estimator and sensitivity analysis; unidentified effects are NOT_IDENTIFIED and assumption-heavy ones ASSUMPTION_DEPENDENT
causal_assumptions.observational_impact: ASSUMPTION_DEPENDENT (no randomized design exists in public data)

resource_ceilings.on_exceed: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; budget increases require an amendment before outcome inspection

failure_semantics.engineering_invalid: retain the attempt, ledger it, fix the root cause with a regression test, rerun in a new directory on the same design and seeds
failure_semantics.resource_failure: resume via checkpoint or registered resource-safe retry

amendment_policy: amendments are ledgered before any affected guarded data are read; the confirmatory registry is amendable only before any confirmatory access

exclusions.prior_versions: every v0.5-v0.8 dataset and calendar period is imported as consumed
exclusions.claims: no live alpha, profitability, production/HFT or exact historical fill claim

data_quality.rule: a day is AVAILABLE when every check passes, else QUALITY_REJECTED (retained; the slot is replaced by the next registered backup)
data_quality.trade_consistency: a print is grossly inconsistent when it lies more than 20 bps outside the touch range of its own and the neighbouring 100 ms bins (sweeps and book quantization legitimately put prints beyond the touch of their own bin; that count is reported, not used)
data_quality.registered_before: any explore, confirm or final access (development day only was read)

day_cache.frames: 100 ms bins over the UTC day in the v0.8 EventFrame layout (state at bin start = book after every message with ts < bin start)
day_cache.event_inference: visible-level size increase = add; decrease explained first by passive-side prints at that price in the same or previous bin (market), remainder = cancel; market counts = prints per aggressor side
day_cache.deep: top-200 non-contiguous levels per side every second from warmup start to horizon end + 30 s of each registered window
day_cache.l1_sources: Binance caches hold L1 only; deeper levels are unobserved (0)

cost_endpoints.primary: is_net_bps: side x (volume-weighted execution price incl. residual valuation - arrival mid) / arrival mid x 1e4 + registered fees (taker 5.5 bps on aggressive fills, maker 2.0 bps on passive fills) + 25 bps x unfilled fraction at the horizon (hard completion: policies cross at the deadline)
cost_endpoints.secondary: is_gross_bps (same without fees and penalty), completion, time to completion, participation
cost_endpoints.mean_is_bps: mean of is_net_bps over the unit's registered windows
cost_endpoints.cvar90_is_bps: CVaR at level 0.90 of is_net_bps over the unit's registered windows (mean of the worst 10%, linear interpolation)
cost_endpoints.markout5s_bps: fill-weighted side x (mid at fill time + 5 s - fill price) / arrival mid x 1e4 over hypothetical passive fills (positive = favourable)
cost_endpoints.bounded: under bounded replay every endpoint is an interval [optimistic, conservative]; a pairwise direction is historically identified only when both bounds agree in sign beyond the threshold

grid_normalization.rule: the price grid used is the coarser of the registered tick and the archive's observed decimal price precision (first 2000 messages); the size grid is the finer of the registered lot and the observed size precision; every difference is recorded as a known anomaly in the dataset's quality report
grid_normalization.reason: the spot-format development day showed a 0.1 observed price precision against a registered 0.01 tick; a finer-than-observed tick would distort spread-in-ticks, visible-level and queue features
grid_normalization.registered_before: any explore, confirm or final access
